name: mermaid-mcp-app
description: Render Mermaid diagrams as interactive, zoomable UI panels inside Claude Desktop.
long_description: An MCP App that renders Mermaid diagrams as interactive, zoomable UI panels — inline inside Claude Desktop. Supports 13 diagram types: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, git graphs, mindmaps, timelines, user journeys, requirement diagrams, and quadrant charts. Features pan & zoom, fit-to-container, copy SVG, source code viewer, and automatic dark/light theme detection.

tools.name: render-mermaid
tools.description: Render a Mermaid diagram from Mermaid syntax. Supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, Gantt charts, pie charts, gitgraph, mindmaps, timelines, and more.
